desc:
VANILLA FLAVORED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored vanilla frosting; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: One 16 oz tub of Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Artificially Flavored Vanilla Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Ready-to-Use: No mixing or preparation needed.

Rich & Creamy Texture: Smooth consistency for easy spreading.

Classic Vanilla Flavor: Sweet, familiar taste everyone enjoys.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for those avoiding gluten.

Versatile Use: Great for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and creative desserts.

Shelf-Stable: Stores easily at room temperature until opened.

Benefits:

Convenience: Saves time during baking or decorating.

Perfect for All Skill Levels: Whether you’re a beginner or pro, it’s easy to use.

Kid-Friendly Taste: A hit at birthday parties and celebrations.

Decorating Made Simple: Ideal for quick frosting and piping.

Reliable Quality: Trusted brand with consistent texture and flavor.
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Yellows 5 & 6, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
